events.title: Edge AI & Computer Vision with OpenCV and Embedded Systems
events.description: Explore the convergence of hardware and artificial intelligence with practical demonstrations of YOLOv8 model quantization and edge inferencing.
events.short_description: Learn real-time object detection, facial recognition, and drone tracking on micro-computing platforms like Raspberry Pi and Jetson Nano.
events.venue: Internet of Things (IoT) & Robotics Center of Excellence
events.speaker: Prof. M. K. Chaitanya
events.speaker_bio: Associate Professor & Robotics Lab Director, DRKVSRIT
highlights: Hardware kits provided during the workshop
Take-home code repositories and practical documentation

events.title: NeuroHack 2026: 24-Hour State-Level AI Hackathon
events.description: NeuroHack 2026 is the flagship annual hackathon organized by the IntelliGenZ Club, Department of CSE (AIML) & AI at Dr. K. V. Subba Reddy Institute of Technology. Four tracks: Generative AI, Healthcare & Vision AI, Smart Campus, and Open Innovation.
events.short_description: Build real-world AI, Machine Learning, and Computer Vision solutions in an intense 24-hour hackathon with cash prizes up to ₹50,000.
events.venue: Main Auditorium & Advanced AI Labs, DR. K. V. SUBBA REDDY INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY
events.speaker: Er. Rajesh Varma
events.speaker_bio: Principal AI Architect at TechCorp Labs & Ex-Google Developer Expert
highlights: Cloud compute credits for all qualified teams

events.title: Deep Dive: Building Autonomous Agents with Gemini & LangChain
events.description: Intensive technical bootcamp providing step-by-step guidance on structuring retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, grounding with search, and deploying multi-turn conversational agents.
events.short_description: A hands-on, zero-to-one masterclass on building tool-calling multi-agent AI systems using Gemini models and modern frameworks.
events.venue: Seminar Hall 2 & Embedded AI Lab, DR. K. V. SUBBA REDDY INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY
events.speaker: Dr. Priya Sundaram
events.speaker_bio: AI Research Scientist & Lead Contributor to Open-Source LLM Tools
highlights: Live deployment of production agent pipelines
Hands-on coding with official API keys provided
Certificate of Workshop Completion for attendees
GitHub starter templates & cloud sandboxes included

events.title: CodeClash 2026: Algorithmic Duel & Speed Programming
events.description: Annual collegiate coding clash hosted on competitive programming platforms with real-time scoreboards, automated evaluation, and leaderboards.
events.short_description: Fast-paced speed programming contest testing dynamic programming, graph traversal, and optimized algorithmic problem-solving.
events.speaker: IntelliGenZ Technical Board
events.speaker_bio: Department of CSE (AIML) & AI Competitive Programming Leads
highlights: Live dynamic leaderboard and automated test harness
Medals and certificates for top 10 finalists
Technical problem breakdown session by faculty

announcements.title: NeuroHack 2026 Registrations are Officially Live!
announcements.content: We are thrilled to unveil NeuroHack 2026, the premier state-level 24-Hour AI Hackathon organized by the IntelliGenZ Club at DR. K. V. SUBBA REDDY INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY. Cash prize pool of ₹50,000 across 4 technical tracks.
announcements.summary: Registrations are now open for the state-level 24-Hour AI hackathon. Form your teams and register before seats fill up.
announcements.author: K. V. Sai Kiran

announcements.title: IntelliGenZ Core Committee & Technical Team Recruitment 2026-27
announcements.content: IntelliGenZ Club is expanding its leadership team. We invite 2nd, 3rd, and 4th-year engineering students to apply across Technical, Design, Media, and Management divisions.
announcements.summary: Looking for passionate AI developers, UI/UX designers, event coordinators, and content creators. Apply today.
announcements.author: Dr. S. K. Basha

announcements.title: Club Members Publish Computer Vision Research in International Conference
announcements.content: A proud milestone for IntelliGenZ: research on Automated Diabetic Retinopathy Classification using lightweight Vision Transformers has been accepted for publication with faculty co-authorship.
announcements.summary: Two 3rd-year CSE (AIML) club members got their multimodal medical imaging research paper accepted.
announcements.author: Editorial Board

announcements.title: Team IntelliGenZ Secures 1st Prize at National Smart India Hackathon Regional
announcements.content: Huge congratulations to team members for their outstanding performance at the national smart agriculture challenge, building real-time soil analysis using edge sensor telemetry and predictive neural nets.
announcements.summary: Our student team won the ₹1,00,000 grand prize for an AI-powered smart agriculture yield forecasting system.
announcements.author: President Office

announcements.title: Weekly AI Study Circles & Coding Sprints Launching Every Saturday
announcements.content: Starting this weekend, IntelliGenZ will host weekly in-person peer learning circles in the AI Lab from 02:00 PM to 05:00 PM every Saturday.
announcements.summary: Join our student-led weekend peer circles covering PyTorch, Hugging Face transformers, and Kaggle competitions.
announcements.author: Technical Lead

projects.title: MedVision: Automated Chest X-Ray Pathology Screener
projects.name: MedVision: Automated Chest X-Ray Pathology Screener
projects.description: Deep learning diagnostic assistant classifying 14 common thoracic conditions with Grad-CAM visual heatmaps.
projects.short_description: Clinical radiologist assistant with localized pathology heatmaps.

projects.title: CampusGPT: College Knowledge Engine & Student Copilot
projects.name: CampusGPT: College Knowledge Engine & Student Copilot
projects.description: Retrieval-augmented conversational agent indexed on syllabi, academic calendars, timetables, and college regulations.
projects.short_description: RAG-based campus assistant answering student queries in real time.

projects.title: Facial Recognition & QR Smart Attendance Terminal
projects.name: Facial Recognition & QR Smart Attendance Terminal
projects.description: High-throughput offline attendance station recording participant check-ins with anti-spoofing verification.
projects.short_description: Sub-second check-in system with encrypted dynamic QR verification.

projects.title: AgriBot: Smart Crop Disease Detection & Soil Health Monitor
projects.name: AgriBot: Smart Crop Disease Detection & Soil Health Monitor
projects.description: Mobile application for farmers offering instant leaf disease diagnosis and NPK fertilizer recommendations.
projects.short_description: Mobile leaf pathology scanner with local language voice output.

projects.title: Autonomous Surveillance Drone with Onboard Object Detection
projects.name: Autonomous Surveillance Drone with Onboard Object Detection
projects.description: Custom quadcopter running YOLOv8 on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano for search-and-rescue obstacle avoidance.
projects.short_description: Edge AI drone tracking and real-time inference on edge computing platform.
